initial_document_content:
# Welcome to VectOrEdit
*Feel free to edit or delete this text.*
The embedding model runs locally, so nothing you type is sent to or recorded on the internet.
Vect-or-edit is an editor specialized in vector inference.
Unlike an LLM, vector inference reflects the results of the dictionary.

In this editor, inference results are quantified and sorted as far as possible.
Using your own dictionary file lets you work in a more optimized environment.

To make the text follow certain writing rules or a format, set a guideline.

Basic use.
Load a KNOWLEDGE file and turn EMBED on (installed by default).
Write in the editor. Select a character or word and the dictionary runs automatically.
The right area shows the calculated results, ordered by match percentage.

To save, press SAVE at the top of the editor, or Ctrl+S.
Double-click a tab to rename the file.

Without a KNOWLEDGE file loaded, this is an ordinary notepad and text editor, but vector inference does not run. Right-click search with Google still works.

## Main ways to use it (try them right here)
- **Context menu**: Cut, Copy, Paste, plus Google search, LLM chat and rewrite
- **AI Suggest**: Works once knowledge is loaded. Select text, then pick "AI Suggest" from the menu. Related knowledge shows up in the right sidebar (or press Alt+S)
- **AutoSave**: Switch it in the menu beside SAVE (the arrow); the light on SAVE shows whether it is on

## Settings from the first-run setup
- Language and theme, save location and folder name, file format, AutoSave and AI run on the choices you made in the first-run setup
- To change them, open Settings (the gear button in the header, or Ctrl+,). You can change language, theme, save location, file format, AI models and cloud AI keys

## What is in the VectOrEdit window
Hover over most items to see what they do.
- Theme, language, window size and the like are in Settings
- The menu bar at the top (File, Edit, View, Window, Help) works like Notepad's
- **Left (main area)**: The Monaco editor. Adjust AutoSave, background color, font family and size. Tabs show the file name and have buttons to duplicate and to open a new tab. The LLM button switches ON and OFF
- **Right (embedding area)**: Load guidelines and KNOWLEDGE. Both accept several files. Guidelines are optional
- Drag to resize the areas, or use the open and close buttons

## LLM and embedding: the difference
- **LLM**: Writes or operates on your text for you, the same as asking an AI to write. Everything works without it
- **Embedding**: The model that runs behind the scenes when you pick "AI Suggest" from the right-click menu. It reflects the dictionary data you loaded and finds related knowledge
- Inference differs between a single selected word and a longer selection
- Results are ordered by match percentage. You can set the threshold
- The model is downloaded and runs locally. Unless you use a cloud AI, everything stays on this PC

## When something goes wrong
- The LOG row is at the bottom of the window (the footer)
- If something breaks, copy the log and show it to an AI
- To check that everything is healthy, press the pipeline button in the Logs row. The lights mean: green is ready, yellow is loading, gray is on standby (not started), red is a fault
Lights also show when no model is installed.

To switch between a Markdown file and plain text, click "Markdown" at the lower right of the editor; it changes to Text. This changes the file's save format.
For Markdown there is a Preview button at the lower right.
Files are saved as UTF-8.

The character and line counts are at the lower left.

setting_log_time_zone_desc: The time zone of the log times. Local shows this computer's time zone (the default). UTC shows Coordinated Universal Time. ISO 8601 is always UTC, whatever this is set to.
tip_set_log_time_zone: Choose the time zone of the log times
setting_remember_layout_desc: Remembers the height of the log panel and the chat dock and the width of the sidebar, and restores them at the next start. Turning it off forgets them.
tip_set_remember_layout: Keeps the log and chat heights and the sidebar width for the next start
tip_set_logs_on_start: Choose whether the log panel starts open or closed
tip_set_log_time_format: Choose how the time of each log line is shown
vis_group_desc: Show or hide each part of the window with its eye button. Essential parts cannot be hidden.
cloud_emb_desc: Use an external API for semantic search when you need higher accuracy. Local 384-dimension search stays the default. Set the API key in the Editor tab first.
gemini_models_hint: Set the API key, then click "Fetch Models" to get the latest list of Gemini models.
api_keys_clear_desc: Remove locally cached Gemini, OpenAI and Claude API keys from this device. Keys are encrypted with Electron safeStorage.
rename_format_confirm: This extension changes the document format. Highlighting and the saved file type follow the new extension.
log_clear_confirm: Clear all log entries from this window? They cannot be restored.
api_clear_confirm: Remove the API keys for Gemini, OpenAI and Claude from this device?
api_clear_failed: A stored key could not be removed
ai_overview_caption: Local vector search and Cloud LLM features operate independently based on your active configuration.
maint_cache_desc: Clears Electron session cache and temporary renderer resources. It does not delete documents, Knowledge Slots, settings, downloaded model files, or API keys.
tip_capability_help: Shows which features need the embedding model and which need the LLM
hide_notice_restore: Show it again with its eye button in Settings > System > Parts of the window.
hide_notice_guideline_card: The guideline card is hidden. You cannot pick or edit guideline presets.
hide_notice_knowledge_card: The knowledge slots card is hidden. You cannot add or switch knowledge slots.
hide_notice_sidebar: The sidebar is hidden. Suggestions, knowledge slots and guidelines are not shown.
hide_notice_save: The save button is hidden. The autosave LED and the save menu are not shown.
hide_notice_tab_bar: The document tabs are hidden. You cannot switch between open documents.
hide_notice_menu_bar: The menu bar is hidden. The File, Edit, View, Window and Help menus are not shown.
hide_notice_bottom_bar: The bottom bar is hidden. The log button, status and the System settings gear are not shown.
tip_editor_ai_toggle:
LLM assistant: click to switch on or off.
When off: click turns it on and opens the chat dock.
No model: opens Settings
tip_console_toggle: Open or close the log panel
tip_section_editor_options: Click to expand or collapse the Editor Options section
tip_monaco_opts_reset_all: Reset every changed option to its default
tip_monaco_opts_search: Search options by name or description
tip_ctx_llm_chat_rewrite: Start LLM Chat or rewrite with selected text
llm_action_rewrite_tip: Replace selected text with this output (decorated)
settings.editor.inDiffEditor: This editor is used inside a diff editor.
settings.editor.allowVariableLineHeights: This editor is allowed to use variable line heights.
settings.editor.allowVariableFonts: This editor is allowed to use variable font-sizes and font-families
settings.editor.allowVariableFontsInAcce: This editor is allowed to use variable font-sizes and font-families in accessibility mode
settings.editor.ariaLabel: The aria label for the editor's textarea (when it is focused).
settings.editor.ariaRequired: Whether the aria-required attribute should be set on the editors textarea.
settings.editor.screenReaderAnnounceInli: Control whether a screen reader announces inline suggestion content immediately.
settings.editor.tabIndex: The `tabindex` property of the editor's textarea
settings.editor.rulers: Render vertical lines at the specified columns. Defaults to empty array.
settings.editor.wordSegmenterLocales: Locales used for segmenting lines into words when doing word related navigations or operations. Specify the BCP 47 language tag of the word you wish to recognize (e.g., ja, zh-CN, zh-Hant-TW, etc.). Defaults to empty array
settings.editor.wordSeparators: A string containing the word separators used when doing word navigation. Defaults to `~!@#$%^&*()-=+[{]}\\|;:\'",.<>/?
settings.editor.selectionClipboard: Enable Linux primary clipboard. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.lineNumbers: Control the rendering of line numbers. If it is a function, it will be invoked when rendering a line number and the return value will be rendered. Otherwise, if it is a truthy, line numbers will be rendered normally (equivalent of using an identity function). Otherwise, line numbers will not be rendered. Defaults to `on`.
settings.editor.cursorSurroundingLines: Controls the minimal number of visible leading and trailing lines surrounding the cursor. Defaults to 0.
settings.editor.cursorSurroundingLinesSt: Controls when `cursorSurroundingLines` should be enforced Defaults to `default`, `cursorSurroundingLines` is not enforced when cursor position is changed by mouse.
settings.editor.renderFinalNewline: Render last line number when the file ends with a newline. Defaults to 'on' for Windows and macOS and 'dimmed' for Linux.
settings.editor.unusualLineTerminators: Remove unusual line terminators like LINE SEPARATOR (LS), PARAGRAPH SEPARATOR (PS). Defaults to 'prompt'.
settings.editor.selectOnLineNumbers: Should the corresponding line be selected when clicking on the line number? Defaults to true.
settings.editor.lineNumbersMinChars: Control the width of line numbers, by reserving horizontal space for rendering at least an amount of digits. Defaults to 5.
settings.editor.glyphMargin: Enable the rendering of the glyph margin. Defaults to true in vscode and to false in monaco-editor.
settings.editor.lineDecorationsWidth: The width reserved for line decorations (in px). Line decorations are placed between line numbers and the editor content. You can pass in a string in the format floating point followed by "ch". e.g. 1.3ch. Defaults to 10.
settings.editor.revealHorizontalRightPad: When revealing the cursor, a virtual padding (px) is added to the cursor, turning it into a rectangle. This virtual padding ensures that the cursor gets revealed before hitting the edge of the viewport. Defaults to 30 (px).
settings.editor.roundedSelection: Render the editor selection with rounded borders. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.extraEditorClassName: Class name to be added to the editor.
settings.editor.readOnly: Should the editor be read only. See also `domReadOnly`. Defaults to false.
settings.editor.readOnlyMessage: The message to display when the editor is readonly.
settings.editor.domReadOnly: Should the textarea used for input use the DOM `readonly` attribute. Defaults to false.
settings.editor.linkedEditing: Enable linked editing. Defaults to false.
settings.editor.renderValidationDecorati: Should the editor render validation decorations. Defaults to editable.
settings.editor.scrollbar: Control the behavior and rendering of the scrollbars.
settings.editor.stickyScroll: Control the behavior of sticky scroll options
settings.editor.minimap: Control the behavior and rendering of the minimap.
settings.editor.find: Control the behavior of the find widget.
settings.editor.fixedOverflowWidgets: Display overflow widgets as `fixed`. Defaults to `false`.
settings.editor.allowOverflow: Allow content widgets and overflow widgets to overflow the editor viewport. Defaults to `true`.
settings.editor.overviewRulerLanes: The number of vertical lanes the overview ruler should render. Defaults to 3.
settings.editor.overviewRulerBorder: Controls if a border should be drawn around the overview ruler. Defaults to `true`.
settings.editor.cursorBlinking: Control the cursor animation style, possible values are 'blink', 'smooth', 'phase', 'expand' and 'solid'. Defaults to 'blink'.
settings.editor.mouseWheelZoom: Zoom the font in the editor when using the mouse wheel in combination with holding Ctrl. Defaults to false.
settings.editor.mouseStyle: Control the mouse pointer style, either 'text' or 'default' or 'copy' Defaults to 'text'
settings.editor.cursorSmoothCaretAnimati: Enable smooth caret animation. Defaults to 'off'.
settings.editor.cursorStyle: Control the cursor style in insert mode. Defaults to 'line'.
settings.editor.overtypeCursorStyle: Control the cursor style in overtype mode. Defaults to 'block'.
settings.editor.overtypeOnPaste: Controls whether paste in overtype mode should overwrite or insert.
settings.editor.cursorWidth: Control the width of the cursor when cursorStyle is set to 'line'
settings.editor.cursorHeight: Control the height of the cursor when cursorStyle is set to 'line'
settings.editor.fontLigatures: Enable font ligatures. Defaults to false.
settings.editor.fontVariations: Enable font variations. Defaults to false.
settings.editor.defaultColorDecorators: Controls whether to use default color decorations or not using the default document color provider
settings.editor.disableLayerHinting: Disable the use of `transform: translate3d(0px, 0px, 0px)` for the editor margin and lines layers. The usage of `transform: translate3d(0px, 0px, 0px)` acts as a hint for browsers to create an extra layer. Defaults to false.
settings.editor.disableMonospaceOptimiza: Disable the optimizations for monospace fonts. Defaults to false.
settings.editor.hideCursorInOverviewRule: Should the cursor be hidden in the overview ruler. Defaults to false.
settings.editor.scrollBeyondLastLine: Enable that scrolling can go one screen size after the last line. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.scrollBeyondLastColumn: Enable that scrolling can go beyond the last column by a number of columns. Defaults to 5.
settings.editor.smoothScrolling: Enable that the editor animates scrolling to a position. Defaults to false.
settings.editor.automaticLayout: Enable that the editor will install a ResizeObserver to check if its container dom node size has changed. Defaults to false.
settings.editor.wordWrap: Control the wrapping of the editor. When `wordWrap` = "off", the lines will never wrap. When `wordWrap` = "on", the lines will wrap at the viewport width. When `wordWrap` = "wordWrapColumn", the lines will wrap at `wordWrapColumn`. When `wordWrap` = "bounded", the lines will wrap at min(viewport width, wordWrapColumn). Defaults to "off".
settings.editor.wordWrapColumn: Control the wrapping of the editor. When `wordWrap` = "off", the lines will never wrap. When `wordWrap` = "on", the lines will wrap at the viewport width. When `wordWrap` = "wordWrapColumn", the lines will wrap at `wordWrapColumn`. When `wordWrap` = "bounded", the lines will wrap at min(viewport width, wordWrapColumn). Defaults to 80.
settings.editor.wrappingIndent: Control indentation of wrapped lines. Can be: 'none', 'same', 'indent' or 'deepIndent'. Defaults to 'same' in vscode and to 'none' in monaco-editor.
settings.editor.wrappingStrategy: Controls the wrapping strategy to use. Defaults to 'simple'.
settings.editor.wrapOnEscapedLineFeeds: Create a softwrap on every quoted "\n" literal. Defaults to false.
settings.editor.wordWrapBreakBeforeChara: Configure word wrapping characters. A break will be introduced before these characters.
settings.editor.wordWrapBreakAfterCharac: Configure word wrapping characters. A break will be introduced after these characters.
settings.editor.wordBreak: Sets whether line breaks appear wherever the text would otherwise overflow its content box. When wordBreak = 'normal', Use the default line break rule. When wordBreak = 'keepAll', Word breaks should not be used for Chinese/Japanese/Korean (CJK) text. Non-CJK text behavior is the same as for normal.
settings.editor.stopRenderingLineAfter: Performance guard: Stop rendering a line after x characters. Defaults to 10000. Use -1 to never stop rendering
settings.editor.links: Enable detecting links and making them clickable. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.colorDecorators: Enable inline color decorators and color picker rendering.
settings.editor.colorDecoratorsActivated: Controls what is the condition to spawn a color picker from a color dectorator
settings.editor.colorDecoratorsLimit: Controls the max number of color decorators that can be rendered in an editor at once.
settings.editor.comments: Control the behaviour of comments in the editor.
settings.editor.contextmenu: Enable custom contextmenu. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.mouseWheelScrollSensitiv: A multiplier to be used on the `deltaX` and `deltaY` of mouse wheel scroll events. Defaults to 1.
settings.editor.fastScrollSensitivity: FastScrolling mulitplier speed when pressing `Alt` Defaults to 5.
settings.editor.scrollPredominantAxis: Enable that the editor scrolls only the predominant axis. Prevents horizontal drift when scrolling vertically on a trackpad. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.inertialScroll: Make scrolling inertial - mostly useful with touchpad on linux.
settings.editor.columnSelection: Enable that the selection with the mouse and keys is doing column selection. Defaults to false.
settings.editor.multiCursorModifier: The modifier to be used to add multiple cursors with the mouse. Defaults to 'alt'
settings.editor.multiCursorMergeOverlapp: Merge overlapping selections. Defaults to true
settings.editor.multiCursorPaste: Configure the behaviour when pasting a text with the line count equal to the cursor count. Defaults to 'spread'.
settings.editor.multiCursorLimit: Controls the max number of text cursors that can be in an active editor at once.
settings.editor.mouseMiddleClickAction: Enables middle mouse button to open links and Go To Definition
settings.editor.accessibilitySupport: Configure the editor's accessibility support. Defaults to 'auto'. It is best to leave this to 'auto'.
settings.editor.accessibilityPageSize: Controls the number of lines in the editor that can be read out by a screen reader
settings.editor.inlineSuggest: Behavior of inline suggestions (faint ghost text). Enables or disables their rendering, and sets their mode and font.
settings.editor.gotoLocation: What happens when going to a definition or reference with several results: peek, go to it, or both.
settings.editor.quickSuggestions: Enable quick suggestions (shadow suggestions) Defaults to true.
settings.editor.quickSuggestionsDelay: Quick suggestions show delay (in ms) Defaults to 10 (ms)
settings.editor.padding: Controls the spacing around the editor.
settings.editor.autoClosingBrackets: Options for auto closing brackets. Defaults to language defined behavior.
settings.editor.autoClosingComments: Options for auto closing comments. Defaults to language defined behavior.
settings.editor.autoClosingQuotes: Options for auto closing quotes. Defaults to language defined behavior.
settings.editor.autoClosingDelete: Options for pressing backspace near quotes or bracket pairs.
settings.editor.autoClosingOvertype: Options for typing over closing quotes or brackets.
settings.editor.autoSurround: Options for auto surrounding. Defaults to always allowing auto surrounding.
settings.editor.autoIndent: Controls whether the editor should automatically adjust the indentation when users type, paste, move or indent lines. Defaults to advanced.
settings.editor.autoIndentOnPaste: Boolean which controls whether to autoindent on paste
settings.editor.autoIndentOnPasteWithinS: Boolean which controls whether to autoindent on paste within a string when autoIndentOnPaste is enabled.
settings.editor.stickyTabStops: Emulate selection behaviour of tab characters when using spaces for indentation. This means selection will stick to tab stops.
settings.editor.formatOnType: Enable format on type. Defaults to false.
settings.editor.formatOnPaste: Enable format on paste. Defaults to false.
settings.editor.doubleClickSelectsBlock: Controls whether double-clicking next to a bracket or quote selects the content inside. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.dragAndDrop: Controls if the editor should allow to move selections via drag and drop. Defaults to false.
settings.editor.suggestOnTriggerCharacte: Enable the suggestion box to pop-up on trigger characters. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.acceptSuggestionOnEnter: Accept suggestions on ENTER. Defaults to 'on'.
settings.editor.acceptSuggestionOnCommit: Accept suggestions on provider defined characters. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.emptySelectionClipboard: Copying without a selection copies the current line.
settings.editor.suggestFontSize: The font size for the suggest widget. Defaults to the editor font size.
settings.editor.suggestLineHeight: The line height for the suggest widget. Defaults to the editor line height.
settings.editor.selectionHighlight: Enable selection highlight. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.selectionHighlightMultil: Enable selection highlight for multiline selections. Defaults to false.
settings.editor.selectionHighlightMaxLen: Maximum length (in characters) for selection highlights. Set to 0 to have an unlimited length.
settings.editor.occurrencesHighlight: Enable semantic occurrences highlight. Defaults to 'singleFile'. 'off' disables occurrence highlighting 'singleFile' triggers occurrence highlighting in the current document 'multiFile'  triggers occurrence highlighting across valid open documents
settings.editor.occurrencesHighlightDela: Controls delay for occurrences highlighting Defaults to 250. Minimum value is 0 Maximum value is 2000
settings.editor.codeLens: Show code lens Defaults to true.
settings.editor.codeLensFontFamily: Code lens font family. Defaults to editor font family.
settings.editor.codeLensFontSize: Code lens font size. Default to 90% of the editor font size
settings.editor.lightbulb: Control the behavior and rendering of the code action lightbulb.
settings.editor.codeActionsOnSaveTimeout: Timeout for running code actions on save.
settings.editor.folding: Enable code folding. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.foldingStrategy: Selects the folding strategy. 'auto' uses the strategies contributed for the current document, 'indentation' uses the indentation based folding strategy. Defaults to 'auto'.
settings.editor.foldingHighlight: Enable highlight for folded regions. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.foldingImportsByDefault: Auto fold imports folding regions. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.foldingMaximumRegions: Maximum number of foldable regions. Defaults to 5000.
settings.editor.showFoldingControls: Controls whether the fold actions in the gutter stay always visible or hide unless the mouse is over the gutter. Defaults to 'mouseover'.
settings.editor.unfoldOnClickAfterEndOfL: Controls whether clicking on the empty content after a folded line will unfold the line. Defaults to false.
settings.editor.matchBrackets: Enable highlighting of matching brackets. Defaults to 'always'.
settings.editor.experimentalGpuAccelerat: Enable experimental rendering using WebGPU. Defaults to 'off'.
settings.editor.experimentalWhitespaceRe: Enable experimental whitespace rendering. Defaults to 'svg'.
settings.editor.renderWhitespace: Enable rendering of whitespace. Defaults to 'selection'.
settings.editor.renderControlCharacters: Enable rendering of control characters. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.renderLineHighlight: Enable rendering of current line highlight. Defaults to all.
settings.editor.renderLineHighlightOnlyW: Control if the current line highlight should be rendered only the editor is focused. Defaults to false.
settings.editor.useTabStops: Inserting and deleting whitespace follows tab stops.
settings.editor.trimWhitespaceOnDelete: Controls whether the editor should automatically remove indentation whitespace when joining lines with Delete. Defaults to false.
settings.editor.showUnused: Controls fading out of unused variables.
settings.editor.peekWidgetDefaultFocus: Controls whether to focus the inline editor in the peek widget by default. Defaults to false.
settings.editor.placeholder: Sets a placeholder for the editor. If set, the placeholder is shown if the editor is empty.
settings.editor.definitionLinkOpensInPee: Controls whether the definition link opens element in the peek widget. Defaults to false.
settings.editor.matchOnWordStartOnly: Controls whether suggestions allow matches in the middle of the word instead of only at the beginning
settings.editor.inlayHints: Control the behavior and rendering of the inline hints.
settings.editor.useShadowDOM: Control if the editor should use shadow DOM.
settings.editor.guides: Controls the behavior of editor guides.
settings.editor.unicodeHighlight: Controls the behavior of the unicode highlight feature (by default, ambiguous and invisible characters are highlighted).
settings.editor.bracketPairColorization: Configures bracket pair colorization (disabled by default).
settings.editor.dropIntoEditor: Controls dropping into the editor from an external source. When enabled, this shows a preview of the drop location and triggers an `onDropIntoEditor` event.
settings.editor.editContext: Sets whether the new experimental edit context should be used instead of the text area.
settings.editor.renderRichScreenReaderCo: Controls whether to render rich HTML screen reader content when the EditContext is enabled
settings.editor.pasteAs: Controls support for changing how content is pasted into the editor.
settings.editor.tabFocusMode: Controls whether the editor / terminal receives tabs or defers them to the workbench for navigation.
settings.editor.inlineCompletionsAccessi: Controls whether the accessibility hint should be provided to screen reader users when an inline completion is shown.
settings.editor.tabSize: The number of spaces a tab is equal to. This setting is overridden based on the file contents when `detectIndentation` is on. Defaults to 4.
settings.editor.insertSpaces: Insert spaces when pressing `Tab`. This setting is overridden based on the file contents when `detectIndentation` is on. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.detectIndentation: Controls whether `tabSize` and `insertSpaces` will be automatically detected when a file is opened based on the file contents. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.trimAutoWhitespace: Remove trailing auto inserted whitespace. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.largeFileOptimizations: Special handling for large files to disable certain memory intensive features. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.wordBasedSuggestions: Controls whether completions should be computed based on words in the document. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.wordBasedSuggestionsOnly: Controls whether word based completions should be included from opened documents of the same language or any language.
settings.editor.semanticHighlighting.ena: Controls whether the semanticHighlighting is shown for the languages that support it. true: semanticHighlighting is enabled for all themes false: semanticHighlighting is disabled for all themes 'configuredByTheme': semanticHighlighting is controlled by the current color theme's semanticHighlighting setting. Defaults to 'byTheme'.
settings.editor.stablePeek: Keep peek editors open even when double-clicking their content or when hitting `Escape`. Defaults to false.
settings.editor.maxTokenizationLineLengt: Lines above this length will not be tokenized for performance reasons. Defaults to 20000.
settings.editor.theme: Theme to be used for rendering. The current out-of-the-box available themes are: 'vs' (default), 'vs-dark', 'hc-black', 'hc-light'. You can create custom themes via `monaco.editor.defineTheme`. To switch a theme, use `monaco.editor.setTheme`. **NOTE**: The theme might be overwritten if the OS is in high contrast mode, unless `autoDetectHighContrast` is set to false.
settings.editor.autoDetectHighContrast: If enabled, will automatically change to high contrast theme if the OS is using a high contrast theme. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.scrollbar.arrowSize: The size of arrows (if displayed). Defaults to 11. **NOTE**: This option cannot be updated using `updateOptions()`
settings.editor.scrollbar.useShadows: Cast horizontal and vertical shadows when the content is scrolled. Defaults to true. **NOTE**: This option cannot be updated using `updateOptions()`
settings.editor.scrollbar.verticalHasArr: Render arrows at the top and bottom of the vertical scrollbar. Defaults to false. **NOTE**: This option cannot be updated using `updateOptions()`
settings.editor.scrollbar.horizontalHasA: Render arrows at the left and right of the horizontal scrollbar. Defaults to false. **NOTE**: This option cannot be updated using `updateOptions()`
settings.editor.scrollbar.handleMouseWhe: Listen to mouse wheel events and react to them by scrolling. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.scrollbar.alwaysConsumeM: Always consume mouse wheel events (always call preventDefault() and stopPropagation() on the browser events). Defaults to true. **NOTE**: This option cannot be updated using `updateOptions()`
settings.editor.scrollbar.horizontalScro: Height in pixels for the horizontal scrollbar. Defaults to 12 (px).
settings.editor.scrollbar.verticalScroll: Width in pixels for the vertical scrollbar. Defaults to 14 (px).
settings.editor.scrollbar.verticalSlider: Width in pixels for the vertical slider. Defaults to `verticalScrollbarSize`. **NOTE**: This option cannot be updated using `updateOptions()`
settings.editor.scrollbar.horizontalSlid: Height in pixels for the horizontal slider. Defaults to `horizontalScrollbarSize`. **NOTE**: This option cannot be updated using `updateOptions()`
settings.editor.scrollbar.scrollByPage: Scroll gutter clicks move by page vs jump to position. Defaults to false.
settings.editor.scrollbar.ignoreHorizont: When set, the horizontal scrollbar will not increase content height. Defaults to false.
settings.editor.stickyScroll.maxLineCoun: Maximum number of sticky lines to show
settings.editor.stickyScroll.defaultMode: Model to choose for sticky scroll by default
settings.editor.stickyScroll.scrollWithE: Define whether to scroll sticky scroll with editor horizontal scrollbae
settings.editor.minimap.enabled: Enable the rendering of the minimap. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.minimap.side: Control the side of the minimap in editor. Defaults to 'right'.
settings.editor.minimap.size: Control the minimap rendering mode. Defaults to 'actual'.
settings.editor.minimap.showSlider: Control the rendering of the minimap slider. Defaults to 'mouseover'.
settings.editor.minimap.renderCharacters: Render the actual text on a line (as opposed to color blocks). Defaults to true.
settings.editor.minimap.maxColumn: Limit the width of the minimap to render at most a certain number of columns. Defaults to 120.
settings.editor.minimap.scale: Relative size of the font in the minimap. Defaults to 1.
settings.editor.minimap.showRegionSectio: Whether to show named regions as section headers. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.minimap.showMarkSectionH: Whether to show MARK: comments as section headers. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.minimap.sectionHeaderFon: Font size of section headers. Defaults to 9.
settings.editor.minimap.sectionHeaderLet: Spacing between the section header characters (in CSS px). Defaults to 1.
settings.editor.find.cursorMoveOnType: Controls whether the cursor should move to find matches while typing.
settings.editor.find.findOnType: Controls whether the find widget should search as you type.
settings.editor.find.seedSearchStringFro: Controls if we seed search string in the Find Widget with editor selection.
settings.editor.find.autoFindInSelection: Controls if Find in Selection flag is turned on in the editor.
settings.editor.find.loop: Controls whether the search result and diff result automatically restarts from the beginning (or the end) when no further matches can be found
settings.editor.find.closeOnResult: Controls whether to close the Find Widget after an explicit find navigation command lands on a match.
settings.editor.hover.delay: Delay for showing the hover. Defaults to 300.
settings.editor.hover.sticky: Is the hover sticky such that it can be clicked and its contents selected? Defaults to true.
settings.editor.hover.hidingDelay: Controls how long the hover is visible after you hovered out of it. Require sticky setting to be true.
settings.editor.hover.above: Should the hover be shown above the line if possible? Defaults to false.
settings.editor.hover.showLongLineWarnin: Should long line warning hovers be shown (tokenization skipped, rendering paused)? Defaults to true.
settings.editor.comments.insertSpace: Insert a space after the line comment token and inside the block comments tokens. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.comments.ignoreEmptyLine: Ignore empty lines when inserting line comments. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.suggest.insertMode: Overwrite word ends on accept. Default to false.
settings.editor.suggest.filterGraceful: Enable graceful matching. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.suggest.snippetsPreventQ: Prevent quick suggestions when a snippet is active. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.suggest.localityBonus: Favors words that appear close to the cursor.
settings.editor.suggest.shareSuggestSele: Enable using global storage for remembering suggestions.
settings.editor.suggest.selectionMode: Select suggestions when triggered via quick suggest or trigger characters
settings.editor.suggest.showIcons: Enable or disable icons in suggestions. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.suggest.showStatusBar: Enable or disable the suggest status bar.
settings.editor.suggest.preview: Enable or disable the rendering of the suggestion preview.
settings.editor.suggest.previewMode: Configures the mode of the preview.
settings.editor.suggest.showInlineDetail: Show details inline with the label. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.suggest.matchOnWordStart: Controls whether suggestions allow matches in the middle of the word instead of only at the beginning
settings.editor.inlineSuggest.enabled: Enable or disable the rendering of automatic inline completions.
settings.editor.inlineSuggest.mode: Configures the mode. Use `prefix` to only show ghost text if the text to replace is a prefix of the suggestion text. Use `subword` to only show ghost text if the replace text is a subword of the suggestion text. Use `subwordSmart` to only show ghost text if the replace text is a subword of the suggestion text, but the subword must start after the cursor position. Defaults to `prefix`.
settings.editor.inlineSuggest.keepOnBlur: Does not clear active inline suggestions when the editor loses focus.
settings.editor.padding.top: Spacing between top edge of editor and first line.
settings.editor.padding.bottom: Spacing between bottom edge of editor and last line.
settings.editor.parameterHints.enabled: Enable parameter hints. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.parameterHints.cycle: Enable cycling of parameter hints. Defaults to false.
settings.editor.lightbulb.enabled: Enable the lightbulb code action. The three possible values are `off`, `on` and `onCode` and the default is `onCode`. `off` disables the code action menu. `on` shows the code action menu on code and on empty lines. `onCode` shows the code action menu on code only.
settings.editor.inlayHints.enabled: Enable the inline hints. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.inlayHints.fontSize: Font size of inline hints. Default to 90% of the editor font size.
settings.editor.inlayHints.fontFamily: Font family of inline hints. Defaults to editor font family.
settings.editor.inlayHints.padding: Enables the padding around the inlay hint. Defaults to false.
settings.editor.inlayHints.maximumLength: Maximum length for inlay hints per line Set to 0 to have an unlimited length.
settings.editor.guides.bracketPairs: Enable rendering of bracket pair guides. Defaults to false.
settings.editor.guides.bracketPairsHoriz: Enable rendering of vertical bracket pair guides. Defaults to 'active'.
settings.editor.guides.highlightActiveBr: Enable highlighting of the active bracket pair. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.guides.indentation: Enable rendering of indent guides. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.guides.highlightActiveIn: Enable highlighting of the active indent guide. Defaults to true.
settings.editor.unicodeHighlight.nonBasi: Controls whether all non-basic ASCII characters are highlighted. Only characters between U+0020 and U+007E, tab, line-feed and carriage-return are considered basic ASCII.
settings.editor.unicodeHighlight.invisib: Controls whether characters that just reserve space or have no width at all are highlighted.
settings.editor.unicodeHighlight.ambiguo: Controls whether characters are highlighted that can be confused with basic ASCII characters, except those that are common in the current user locale.
settings.editor.unicodeHighlight.include: Controls whether characters in comments should also be subject to unicode highlighting.
Controls whether characters in strings should also be subject to unicode highlighting.
